strategy_roster.name: Majors Volume Sum

strategy_roster.name: Sprut Pending Order Grid
strategy_roster.notes: Reference strategy is not expressible as a deterministic single-security OHLCV entry signal in the TASI DSL; a never-true guard is used rather than fabricating a signal. strategy_roster.name: Inverse Reaction
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.
